g.title: cluster_detector
g.text: Serial loop: one detector at a time

g.title: admit
g.text: Check paths, identities, geometry and BPM bindings

g.title: settings
g.text: TOML or retained PAF + explicit options

g.title: setup
g.text: Create common QC archive, exclusive log
and private work directory under reduced destination

g.title: load
g.text: Load this detector from every input
Validate pixel data; prepare private copies / BPM

g.title: rawqc
g.text: Measure raw active and scan statistics

g.title: scan
g.text: Rank-rejected mean of enabled scan columns
No detector BPM on scan samples

g.title: trim
g.text: Use good BPM pixels, or explicit omission

g.title: reject
g.text: Select whole frames once from corrected means
Keep only L < mean < U; require minimum survivors

g.title: stack
g.text: Median stack all active pixel positions
Eclipse lower-middle median for even counts
BPM does not replace output pixels

g.title: failure
g.text: Nonzero exit; retain log and diagnostic evidence
Partial outputs do not mean whole-recipe success

g.title: record
g.text: Copy measurements and context into common record
Input identities, rejection reasons and provenance

g.title: private
g.text: Serialize scalar/context QC from that record
Write private detector FITS with legacy + new QC
Release detector images and temporary owners

g.title: writer
g.text: Native ASDF writer and readback validation
Full common QC archive, arrays and provenance

g.title: assemble
g.text: One final FITS; preserve detector pixel payloads

g.title: fits
g.text: Images + legacy and new scalar QC

g.title: done
g.text: Remove private detector files / work directory
Finalize log; zero command exit required
